## Problem and result

Describe the concrete change and its scope.

## Verification

Record only checks actually run, their environment, and limitations. For docs-only changes, validate documents and the diff; do not rebuild the app unnecessarily.

## Documentation and remaining work

- Current status/stage/backlog updated, or state why no change is needed.
- API/route/design documentation updated when affected.
- Evidence stored with repository-relative links and an environment/commit label.
- Remaining work and access dependencies stated without implying implementation.

## Deployment

State whether production is authorized for this change. After a product release, record source SHA, deployment ID, alias and actual behavior checked. A documentation-only deployment is not a new feature release.
